# Consolidate repr/deep_copy into dataclass.cc; add recursive hash/compare APIs and auto-generated __ffi_init__

## TL;DR
- Merges `deep_copy.cc` and `repr_print.cc` into a unified `dataclass.cc` backed by a shared `ObjectGraphDFS` CRTP engine, eliminating duplicated graph-walking logic.
- Adds new public C++ APIs for recursive structural hash and comparison (`RecursiveHash`, `RecursiveEq`, `RecursiveLt/Le/Gt/Ge`) with per-field opt-out via `refl::compare(false)` and `refl::hash(false)` traits.
- Auto-generates `__ffi_init__` packed constructors from reflection metadata in `ObjectDef` destructor, with new field traits `refl::init(false)`, `refl::kw_only(true)`, `refl::default_value`, `refl::default_factory`.

## Key Exports

```python
# --- Public C++ APIs (include/tvm/ffi/extra/dataclass.h) ---

def DeepCopy(value: Any) -> Any: ...
    # Interacts with: ObjectGraphDFS, reflection field metadata, container traversal
    # Invariant: all reachable objects must be copy-constructible or immutable

def ReprPrint(value: Any) -> String: ...
    # Interacts with: ObjectGraphDFS, __ffi_repr__ type attribute hook
    # Invariant: handles cycles (prints "...") and DAGs (caches repr strings)

def RecursiveHash(value: Any) -> int64: ...
    # Interacts with: ObjectGraphDFS, __ffi_hash__ type attribute hook
    # Invariant: RecursiveEq(a, b) => RecursiveHash(a) == RecursiveHash(b)
    # Extension: register custom __ffi_hash__ via TypeAttrDef

def RecursiveEq(lhs: Any, rhs: Any) -> bool: ...
    # Interacts with: ObjectGraphDFS, __ffi_eq__ type attribute hook
    # Invariant: structural equality, handles cycles via paired visit tracking
    # Extension: register custom __ffi_eq__ via TypeAttrDef

def RecursiveLt(lhs: Any, rhs: Any) -> bool: ...
def RecursiveLe(lhs: Any, rhs: Any) -> bool: ...
def RecursiveGt(lhs: Any, rhs: Any) -> bool: ...
def RecursiveGe(lhs: Any, rhs: Any) -> bool: ...
    # Interacts with: ObjectGraphDFS, __ffi_compare__ type attribute hook (3-way)

# --- CRTP engine (internal, src/ffi/extra/dataclass.cc) ---

# class ObjectGraphDFS<Derived, Frame, Result>:
#     """Iterative DFS over object graphs with cycle/DAG handling."""
#     # Shared by: ObjectDeepCopier, ReprPrinter, RecursiveHasher, RecursiveComparer
#     # Invariant: max stack depth = 1 << 20

# --- C ABI field flag bits (include/tvm/ffi/c_api.h) ---

class TVMFFIFieldFlagBitMask(IntEnum):
    CompareOff = 1 << 7   # Exclude from RecursiveEq/Lt/etc.
    HashOff    = 1 << 8   # Exclude from RecursiveHash
    InitOff    = 1 << 9   # Exclude from auto-generated __ffi_init__
    KwOnly     = 1 << 10  # Keyword-only in auto-generated __ffi_init__

# --- Reflection traits (include/tvm/ffi/reflection/registry.h) ---

class refl_repr:       # refl::repr(bool show)
    """Controls field visibility in ReprPrint. Renamed from refl::Repr."""

class refl_compare:    # refl::compare(bool include)
    """Controls field participation in RecursiveEq/Lt/etc."""

class refl_hash:       # refl::hash(bool include)
    """Controls field participation in RecursiveHash."""

class refl_kw_only:    # refl::kw_only(bool is_kw_only)
    """Marks field as keyword-only in auto-generated __ffi_init__."""

class refl_default_value:   # refl::default_value (lowercase alias)
class refl_default_factory: # refl::default_factory (lowercase alias)

# refl::init<>() specialization: doubles as InfoTrait
# init(false) as field trait: excludes field from __ffi_init__
# init(false) as ObjectDef constructor arg: suppresses auto-init entirely
# CTAD: init(bool) -> init<>

# --- Auto-init (include/tvm/ffi/reflection/init.h) ---

def MakeInit(type_index: int32) -> Function: ...
    # Interacts with: TVMFFITypeInfo.metadata.creator, field reflection, KWARGS sentinel
    # Invariant: positional fields ordered required-first, then optional
    # Extension: ObjectDef destructor calls RegisterAutoInit if no explicit init registered

# ObjectDef<T> destructor auto-registers __ffi_init__ when:
#   1. No explicit refl::init<Args...>() was registered
#   2. Type has a default creator (metadata->creator != nullptr)
#   3. init(false) was NOT passed to ObjectDef constructor

# --- Type attribute names ---
# type_attr::kInit = "__ffi_init__"
# type_attr::kHash = "__ffi_hash__"         (NEW)
# type_attr::kEq = "__ffi_eq__"             (NEW)
# type_attr::kCompare = "__ffi_compare__"   (NEW)

# --- Global function registrations ---
# "ffi.DeepCopy", "ffi.ReprPrint", "ffi.RecursiveHash",
# "ffi.RecursiveEq", "ffi.RecursiveLt"
# plus sentinel functions: "ffi.GetInvalidObject", "ffi.GetKwargsObject"
```

## Impact
- API: **Breaking** — `refl::Repr` renamed to `refl::repr` (lowercase). `include/tvm/ffi/extra/deep_copy.h` removed from public headers (internalized to `src/ffi/object_internal.h`). `test_repr.py` renamed to `test_dataclass_repr.py`.
- Behavioral: `ObjectDef<T>` destructor now auto-registers `__ffi_init__` if no explicit init was provided. All reflected types with a creator gain a packed constructor automatically.
- Flags/config: 4 new C ABI field flag bits (`CompareOff`, `HashOff`, `InitOff`, `KwOnly`).
- Data formats/schemas: None.

## Design Elements
Design elements this commit consumes:
- Reflection system (0008): `ObjectDef<T>`, `InfoTrait`, `ForEachFieldInfo`, `TypeAttrDef`, field getter/setter
- Object system (0002): `ObjectPtr`, `make_object`, `ObjectRef`, `TVMFFIObjectCreator`
- Containers (0006): Array, List, Map, Dict, Shape, Tensor traversal for graph operations
- C ABI (0007): `TVMFFIFieldInfo`, `TVMFFIFieldFlagBitMask`, field flag extension
- Function system (0003): `Function::FromPacked`, `GlobalDef`, KWARGS calling convention

Design elements this commit produces:
- **ObjectGraphDFS CRTP engine**: shared iterative DFS for all object-graph operations (deep copy, repr, hash, compare). Internal only.
- **Recursive hash/compare public APIs**: `RecursiveHash`, `RecursiveEq`, `RecursiveLt/Le/Gt/Ge` in `dataclass.h`
- **Auto-generated `__ffi_init__`**: `MakeInit` + `RegisterAutoInit` in `reflection/init.h`, with KWARGS sentinel protocol
- **Per-field opt-out traits**: `refl::compare(false)`, `refl::hash(false)`, `refl::init(false)`, `refl::kw_only(true)`
- **Type attribute hooks**: `__ffi_hash__`, `__ffi_eq__`, `__ffi_compare__` for custom per-type behavior

## Usage Examples

C++ reflection definition with new traits:
```cpp
refl::ObjectDef<MyNode>()
    .def_rw("name", &MyNode::name)
    .def_rw("cached_hash", &MyNode::cached_hash,
            refl::compare(false), refl::hash(false), refl::init(false),
            refl::default_value(int64_t(0)))
    .def_rw("config", &MyNode::config, refl::kw_only(true));
// Auto-generates __ffi_init__(name, config=...) — cached_hash excluded
```

Python usage of recursive compare:
```python
_recursive_eq = tvm_ffi.get_global_func("ffi.RecursiveEq")
assert _recursive_eq(obj_a, obj_b)  # structural equality across object graphs
```
